fields.help_en:
The display mode of the image. Valid values:

0 (None): The image is not displayed.
1 (Always): The image is always displayed.
2 (Backup): The image is displayed when the current user has no video stream
fields.help_zh:
图片显示，取值：

0（None）：不显示。
1（Always）：总是显示。
2（Backup）：当前用户无视频流时显示
fields.name: display

fields.help_en: The X coordinate, represented as a normalized percentage
fields.name: x

fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The stacking order. 0 indicates the bottom layer, 1 indicates the layer above 0, and so on
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推
fields.name: z_order

fields.help_en: The list of image panes in the current layout
fields.help_zh: 当前布局的图片框位列表
fields.name: images

fields.help_en:
The pane ID. Valid values: 0 to 15.

If the user specified by PaneId is not found, other streams are displayed by default. The streams are determined based on the order in which users join the channel.
If a parameter related to UserPanes is required, all other related parameters are also required. Otherwise, none of them are required
fields.help_zh:
窗格ID，取值：0~15。

当指定的PaneId用户找不到的话，会默认显示其他的流，流的确定是根据用户加入频道的顺序。
如果某个UserPanes相关的参数为必选，则其他相关参数都为必选，反之都为非必选
fields.name: pane_id

fields.help_en:
The user video input that corresponds to the layout. Valid values:

camera (default): the video stream.
shareScreen: the screen sharing stream
fields.help_zh:
对应布局的用户视频输入。取值：

camera（默认）：视频流。
shareScreen：共享屏幕流
fields.name: source_type

fields.name: font_color

fields.help_zh: 字体大小。字体合理范围(0, 72]

4: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_LIGHT.
5: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_MEDIUM
fields.name: font_type

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported and the ID must be unique. The ID must be 1 to 55 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。仅支持传单个ID，需保证唯一。由1~55位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing configuration of the task. You are charged based on your settings. For more information, see the TaskProfile enum values below.

The resolution of the MediaEncode encoding option must be less than or equal to the resolution of TaskProfile.
The maximum number of panes in the layout must be less than or equal to the number of input streams specified by TaskProfile
parameters.help_zh:
任务计费配置，根据您的不同设置，进行收费。请参见下文中的TaskProfile枚举值。

编码选项MediaEncode的分辨率需要小于等于TaskProfile的分辨率。
布局最大窗格数需要小于等于TaskProfile的输入路数
parameters.name: task_profile

parameters.help_en: The encoding option. For more information, see the MediaEncode enum values below
parameters.help_zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值
parameters.name: media_encode

parameters.help_en: The configuration template ID. For more information about how to obtain the template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193625.html
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The video source in single-stream recording mode. Valid values:

camera: the camera.
shareScreen: screen sharing.

If the video source is shareScreen and only the camera stream is ingested, the camera stream is recorded. If both the camera stream and the screen sharing stream are ingested, the screen sharing stream is recorded
parameters.help_zh:
单流录制模式下视频源，取值：

camera：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享。

如果视频源为shareScreen，且仅推摄像头流，则录制摄像头流；如果同时推屏幕共享流，则录制屏幕共享流
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The single-stream recording mode. Valid values:

0 (default): records the original stream.
1: records only the audio stream
parameters.help_zh:
单流录制模式，取值：

0（默认值）：录制原始流。
1：仅录制音频流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
The recording mode. Valid values:

0: single-stream recording. Task parameters cannot be modified during the recording process. You cannot call the UpdateRecordTask operation to modify task parameters.
1 (default): mixed-stream recording. Multiple video streams are mixed and output.

Valid parameters in single-stream recording mode: StreamType and SourceType.
Valid parameters in mixed-stream recording mode: TaskProfile, MediaEncode, LayoutIds, BackgroundColor, SubSpecUsers, CropMode, UserPanes, Backgrounds, Watermarks, and ClockWidgets
parameters.help_zh:
录制模式，取值：

0：单流录制，不允许中间修改任务参数（不允许调用UpdateRecordTask接口修改任务参数）。
1（默认值）：合流录制，支持多画面合流输出。

单流录制模式下有效参数：StreamType、SourceType。
合流录制模式下有效参数：TaskProfile、MediaEncode、LayoutIds、BackgroundColor、SubSpecUsers、CropMode、UserPanes、Backgrounds、Watermarks、ClockWidgets
parameters.name: mix_mode

parameters.help_en:
The cropping mode of the video. Valid values:

1: crops the video while maintaining the aspect ratio.
2 (default): adds padding to the video while maintaining the aspect ratio
parameters.help_zh:
视频的裁剪方式。取值：

1：保持比例裁剪。
2：保持比例留边（默认值）
parameters.name: crop_mode
